# StrtotimeUsage

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `StrtotimeUsageInspection`

Two wasteful `strtotime()` idioms: parsing the literal `'now'` just to get the
current timestamp (`time()` does that directly), and passing `time()` as the
base timestamp, which is already the default.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{5,6,7,8} [Before]
<?php
namespace Billing;

function due($spec) {
    $now   = strtotime("Now");
    $other = \strtotime('NOW');
    $next  = strtotime($spec, \time());
    $last  = strtotime('last monday', time());

    $a = strtotime('now ');
    $b = strtotime($spec, $now);
    $c = strtotime($spec, microtime(true));
    $d = strtotime('now', time());
    $e = strtotime();
    return [$now, $other, $next, $last, $a, $b, $c, $d, $e];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
namespace Billing;

function due($spec) {
    $now   = time();
    $other = \time();
    $next  = strtotime($spec);
    $last  = strtotime('last monday');

    $a = strtotime('now ');
    $b = strtotime($spec, $now);
    $c = strtotime($spec, microtime(true));
    $d = strtotime('now');
    $e = strtotime();
    return [$now, $other, $next, $last, $a, $b, $c, $d, $e];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Call time() instead of parsing &#39;now&#39;.</li>
<li>line 6: Call time() instead of parsing &#39;now&#39;.</li>
<li>line 7: The base timestamp already defaults to the current time; drop the time() argument.</li>
<li>line 8: The base timestamp already defaults to the current time; drop the time() argument.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "StrtotimeUsage": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore StrtotimeUsage

/**
 * @noinspection StrtotimeUsageInspection
 */
```
